# Set a new password
{: .no_toc }

Choose a new password from the emailed reset link.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `AUTH-06` |
| **Route** | `/reset-password` · deep link `substratal://reset-password` |
| **Who can use it** | Reset-token holder |
| **Kind** | auth |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (MVP) |
| **On Linux** | Separate `AdwWindow` with `AdwClamp` |

**How you get here:** Deep link `/reset-password?token=…`

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| New password | password-field | body.new_password | strength meter; autofill new-password | AdwPasswordEntryRow |
| Confirm password | password-field | client only | must match | AdwPasswordEntryRow |
| Notice | caption |  | "You'll be signed out on all devices." | GtkLabel .caption .dim-label |
| Save password | primary-button | POST /auth/password/reset |  | GtkButton .suggested-action .pill |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Save password | `POST /auth/password/reset` | 204 → clear local session → AUTH-01 with success banner. 400 → expired link + link to AUTH-05. 422 → field errors. |
